description: Ethereum native-ETH balance snapshot of up to 10 wallets that a community label dataset (brianleect/etherscan-labels, GitHub) tags as Binance, Coinbase or OKX. It is a snapshot of a sample, not total exchange reserves: no token balances, no inflow or outflow history, and the labels are community-made and may be out of date. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
